title: A New Home for Stray Dogs
transcript: A local animal charity is moving its dog shelter to a larger building next month. The new site is on the edge of town, beside a public park. It will have room for twice as many dogs, as well as a covered area for exercise in bad weather. The charity is asking residents to donate old towels and blankets, which can be left at any of its shops. Visits to the new shelter must be arranged by phone.

questions.prompt: What can the new building provide?
questions.explanation: 新场地能容纳两倍数量的狗。

questions.prompt: What are residents asked to give?
questions.explanation: 慈善机构希望居民捐赠旧毛巾和毯子。
